preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 2000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000) representing the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == n + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: The next n lines each contain two integers p_i and c_i (0 ≤ p_i ≤ n, 0 ≤ c_i ≤ n-1), where p_i is the parent of vertex i (0 if root) and c_i is the count of vertices j in subtree of i with a_j < a_i. The input is a valid tree structure.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(p) <= n for line in lines[1:] for p in line.split()[:1]) and all(0 <= int(c) <= n-1 for line in lines[1:] for c in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All p_i and c_i values are within the specified bounds (0 ≤ p_i ≤ n, 0 ≤ c_i ≤ n-1).

preconditions.expression: root_exists := any(int(p) == 0 for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: There exists exactly one root vertex (p_i = 0) in the tree.

postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' followed by a valid assignment of a_i values (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9) if a solution exists, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: solution_exists and all(1 <= int(a) <= 10**9 for a in a_values) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the output contains exactly n integers a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9) representing a valid assignment of values to vertices.

postconditions.expression: solution_exists and all(c_i == sum(1 for j in subtree_of(i) if a_j < a_i) for i in range(1, n+1)) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: For every vertex i, the computed c_i matches the given c_i: the number of vertices j in the subtree of i with a_j < a_i.
If no valid assignment of a_i values exists, the output is 'NO'.
